en.title: Research across Notion pages
en.description: Synthesize multiple Notion sources into a cited brief or comparison.
tasks: Synthesize multiple Notion sources into a cited brief or comparison.
prerequisites: Connected Notion MCP and read access to the source pages.
en.example: Use notion-research-documentation. Compare the three proposals in these Notion pages and cite the evidence for each trade-off.
en.expectedResult: A comparison or report with traceable page links and explicit gaps.
limitations: Unavailable pages cannot be researched; citations must be checked against current source content.
Upstream Codex connector setup commands are version-specific; use your current host’s Notion connection settings.

zh.title: 跨 Notion 页面调研
zh.description: 综合多个 Notion 来源，撰写带引用的简报或对比。
tasks: 综合多个 Notion 来源，撰写带引用的简报或对比。
prerequisites: 已连接 Notion MCP，并具备来源页面读取权限。
zh.example: 请使用 notion-research-documentation：对比这些 Notion 页面中的三个方案，并为各项取舍标注依据。
zh.expectedResult: 含可追溯页面链接和资料缺口的对比或报告。
limitations: 无法访问的页面不能纳入研究，引用需与当前原文核对。
上游 Codex 连接配置命令有版本差异，请使用当前宿主的 Notion 连接设置。
